title: JB Pritzker Says He Used GLP-1s to Lose 80 Pounds
summary: Gov. JB Pritzker of Illinois, widely seen as a potential presidential candidate, revealed in an interview on “CBS Mornings” that he had been on a GLP-1 regimen since 2024.
